This is a lesson on one drum groove the [Backing Track](../../tools/backing-track.qmd) band plays: **Son clave (2-3)**. It is built up from a simpler pattern, one step at a time, and every step is played by the band and written out as it plays. How the examples work: press ▶ Play, switch players in and out with the buttons beside it, and read the band's last four bars on the staff underneath. The tempo slider at the bottom of the page slows everything down.

[All the accompaniment patterns](index.qmd) · [Drum grooves](index.qmd#drums)

## The pattern

The 2-3 son clave on the cross-stick over two bars, a bell pattern on the cymbal and a light kick with the tumbao bass. A drum-kit part for the clave and timbales of a real section; the congas are a player of their own.

It belongs in *Son montuno*. Here it is in the son montuno style with the whole band. Switch the other players off to hear it alone.

## Step 1: Hi-hat: quarter notes

Start with something simpler. Closed hi-hat on every beat, kick on 1 and 3, snare on 2 and 4. The first rock beat. In 3/4: hi-hat on every beat, kick on 1, snare on 3.

This is a pattern of its own: [the lesson on it](drums-hhquarters.qmd) takes it further. Here it is only a step on the way, slowly. The drums play alone first; switch the bass and chords on when it is steady.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="montuno" data-chart="C|F|G7|C" data-tempo="70" data-on="drums" data-staves="drums" data-choice-label="Step:" data-choices='[{"label":"Hi-hat: quarter notes","opts":{"groove":"hhquarters"}}]'></div>

## Step 2: Son clave (2-3), slowly

Now the pattern itself. Compare it with the step before: press each button while the band plays and watch what changes on the staff.

**How to play it.** The 2-3 son clave on the cross-stick over two bars (2 and 3, then 1, the and of 2, 4), a bell pattern on the cymbal, a light kick. Clap the clave first.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="montuno" data-chart="C|F|G7|C" data-tempo="70" data-on="drums" data-staves="drums" data-choice-label="Compare:" data-choices='[{"label":"Son clave (2-3)","opts":{"groove":"clave"}},{"label":"Hi-hat: quarter notes (the step before)","opts":{"groove":"hhquarters"}}]'></div>

## Step 3: Up to tempo, with the band

The whole band, at 100 beats a minute. Play along, then switch the band's drum kit off and take the part yourself.
